correctness.rationale: Stationary convolution exists and is unique by positive-state occupation and contraction. The Markov generator gives the exact second/fourth moment systems and 2x2 lag covariance system; characteristic-root interlacing, factorization of p(D/V), and uniqueness of the fast coefficient zero prove all parameter-uniform claims. The fourth cumulant is strictly positive, including at the unique cancellation stiffness. The standalone checker was run from its actual stored path and passed 1,050 rational cases with five independent-lag comparisons; finite checks are supplemental.

value.rationale: A two-state fluctuating optical trap is a natural experimental and mathematical object; the theorem sharply separates completely-monotone from non-completely-monotone covariance, identifies a distinct inflection boundary, and gives the exact finite asymmetric switching condition where a non-Gaussian stationary process is second-order indistinguishable from equilibrium OU. The precise condition is an observable identification boundary with an independent fourth-cumulant witness; not merely a parameter substitution.
